TcRuntimeType.description: Srh0ConfiguredSearchRecipe is a business object which represents a search recipe. Srh0ConfiguredSearchRecipe will serve as a return value from the business object operations attached to Workspace Object (Example: "getConfigurableContent" and "getImpactingVariability" ). These operations are overwritten at the business object type hierarchy level that knows the search recipe for the requested information for that specific business object type. Srh0ConfiguredSearchRecipe objects are opaque. Their search recipe is used only internally for application specific business operations on server, such as "Build Conditions"(Bcs0). Srh0ConfiguredSearchRecipe objects will not cross the boundary of the Teamcenter server process.
